Definition: Ai, Aja or Ajath, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ai or Aija or Aiath or Hai = "heap of ruins"; 1) a city lying east of Bethel and beside Bethaven near Jericho and the second city taken on the invasion of Canaan; 2) a city of the Ammonites on the east of the Jordan and apparently attached to Heshbon
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
